title: Hippocampal sharp wave-ripple: A cognitive biomarker for episodic memory and planning - PubMed
abstract:
Alteration of the physiological mechanisms supporting SPW-Rs leads to their pathological conversion, "p-ripples," which are a marker of epileptogenic tissue and can be observed in rodent models of schizophrenia and Alzheimer's Disease. Mechanisms for SPW-R genesis and function are discussed in this review. Keywords: epilepsy; imagining; learning; memory; planning. ... Behavior‐dependence of hippocampal LFP activity.
Sharp wave ripples (SPW-Rs) represent the most synchronous population pattern in the mammalian brain. Their excitatory output affects a wide area of the cortex and several subcortical nuclei. SPW-Rs occur during "off-line" states of the brain, associated with consummatory behaviors and non-REM sleep …
